newsitem.title: USA: Rogers to pay $12 mln for Dow Corning unit.
newsitem.headline: Rogers to pay $12 mln for Dow Corning unit.

text.p: Rogers Corp said Monday it has received approvals to acquire Dow Corning Corp's Bisco Products silicone foam business for $12 million.
The transaction is expected to close by the end of the month.

Under the deal, Rogers has agreed to pay $12 million for the unit. The price includes a $1.5 million note payable in six months and bearing eight percent annual interest, while the rest will be in cash.
Rogers and Dow Corning -- a joint venture between Dow Chemical Co and Corning Inc -- have agreed to continue to work together to develop silicone foam resins over a seven-year period.
Rogers develops, manufactures and markets specialty materials and components, including elastomer materials and components.
